_legend: Decisions about the spreadsheet data that the importer rules cannot take on their own (tool/importar.dart). Catalog ids only: never personal data. Each step reads its own section; E8.3 to E8.5 add theirs.

exercises._notBase: Sheet ids that a default exercise also uses for a different exercise: the sheet renamed the row. They become club exercises. cal_sq is 'Sit ups' in the sheet and 'Movilidad de cadera y tobillo' in the base list.
exercises._sameAs: Sheet id -> visible exercise that is the same one under another name. The row adds its category to it instead of creating a duplicate.

athletes._sameAs: Sheet athlete id (Atletas.id) -> display name of the club athlete created by tool/alta.dart, when the sheet's name is not that one. Display names only, never emails.
athletes._testedRmDates: Dates of RMs rows that are the February 2026 test (M1-D4): they get origin 'testeado', the rest 'importado'. The test was measured in February and loaded on 2026-03-01 (reference/DISENO.md, 'Los RMs se midieron una sola vez').

plans._pctCorrections: M1-D4: October 2026 says 85 % where it should say 80 %. Every set of that plan at 'from' becomes 'to', and the ramp below it moves with it (the empty-bar set stays).
